title: PH Air Force confirms incident involving two SF-260 aircraft in Batangas
summary: The Philippine Air Force confirmed that two SF-260 aircraft figured in an incident during a training flight at the Fernando Air Base in Lipa City, Batangas around 3:50 p.m. on Friday.
